about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Senior RPA Developer at Cantu Inc, where I lead the design of our automation framework and architecture standards. Previously at Grupo Koch S.A., I built internal solutions impacting thousands of users across TypeScript, React, Node, and Python stacks.
about.p2: My background blends Business Administration with hands-on engineering — I care about software that delivers measurable ROI, not just clean code. I love micro-frontends, CI/CD pipelines on Azure DevOps, and centralized auth (Keycloak, Azure AD, LDAP3).

bullets: Designed the RPA team's development framework, standardizing architecture and best practices.
Owns solution architecture and team backlog management.
Built an AI agent (LangChain + LangSmith) for triage and support of the tech team and internal users, integrated across every internal platform.
Delivered an app for managing internal licenses and products.
Module Federation with Vite and centralized authentication (SSO with Keycloak) in a single hub across Next.js micro-frontends.
Configures and maintains CI/CD pipelines on Azure DevOps, with Rancher, Argo CD, and Azure environments.
Architected a React/Node/Next/Python construction & maintenance management app integrated with Azure & WhatsApp APIs.
OCR automation of the NF-e flow for expense identification and invoice triage by department, with a React/Next portal for approval hierarchy and spend control.
Tax substitution (ICMS-ST) change system integrated with the ERP, saving 2+ months of yearly team work.
Python API for SKU pricing by geolocation (lat/long), validating prices against the nearest branch.
Built a centralized auth API with Azure AD and LDAP3 (Python).
Data migration between ERPs.
Developed 10+ internal apps in Node.js, Express, and TypeScript serving 10,000+ users.
Delivered Python RPA solutions for finance, saving 2h of manual work per day.
Built React/TS portals exposing real-time progress of internal projects, integrated with Oracle DB and ERP authentication.
Developed an API for suppliers to securely access internal information.
Structured the RPA environment infrastructure.
Migrated legacy apps to Docker with horizontal scaling via Docker Swarm.
Firmware updates for peripherals and corporate hardware.
Handled and centralized the team's technical demands (hardware and software).
Linux retail environment setup and configuration.
